title: Sketches under the memory budget
lead: Brings the per-field sketches under the memory budget. Today each field that crosses a cap holds a fixed 16 KiB HyperLogLog plus a Greenwald-Khanna summary (two for an ambiguous date field). `EstimatedBytes` counts them, but no budget limits them, so a wide table where many fields cross caps can exceed the allowance (sq-11 review: about 280 MB for 2,000 numeric fields, more for ambiguous dates).
boundary: **Not in this slice:** HLL++ bias tables; changing the exact caps.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Owner decision (2026-10-27, sq-11 review), verbatim: "Document now, file a follow-up (Recommended)" (option text: "Write the per-field cost into design.md now. File a slice to bring sketches under the budget, for example by loosening quantile precision as field count grows. Real wide files rarely cross caps on many fields.").

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `src/squalify/Sketches/GreenwaldKhanna.cs`, `HyperLogLog.cs`, `src/squalify/Fields/FieldAccumulator.cs`, `MemoryBudget`: scale sketch precision (GK epsilon, possibly HLL register count) by field count so the total fits the allowance; record the effective values in `limits` and in each field's `rankError` / `relativeStdError`.
- `docs/design.md` (Bounded memory and sketches), `docs/descriptor.md`.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
1. An in-process test on a generated 2,000-column stream where every field crosses its caps: the summed `EstimatedBytes` stays within the allowance.
2. The reported error members match the scaled precision.
3. Goldens for narrow files are unchanged.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `dotnet build squalify.sln -c Release`
- `dotnet test squalify.sln -c Release` (also with `GITHUB_ACTIONS=true`)
- `dotnet format squalify.sln --verify-no-changes`
- `docs/how-it-works.md` updated and re-rendered if section 5 changes.
- `slicer check`

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Worktree `.worktrees/<id>` on branch `<id>`. No agent commits.
